api_send_key: Send your developer API key now. The message will be deleted immediately and the key stored encrypted.

battle_limits: Based only on battles returned by the official API and battles stored since tracking started. Card placements and timing are not available.

connect_hint: To get started, link your Clash Royale player tag.

custom_none_found: None of those cards were found in your collection.
deck_menu_title: 🎴 AI Deck Builder Choose a strategy. Decks are generated only from cards you own, ranked by a transparent scoring engine.

err_bad_tag: ❌ That is not a valid player tag. Tags only contain the characters 0289PYLQGRJCUV.
err_banned: ⛔ Your access to this bot has been revoked.

err_insufficient_cards: Not enough cards to build a deck.
err_invalid_ip: The API key rejected this server's IP address. Add the current egress IP to your key at developer.clashroyale.com, or use a trusted proxy with a stable IP.

err_network: Network error while contacting the API.
err_no_api_key: No Clash Royale developer API key is configured. Add one under Settings → API key, or ask the owner to configure a shared key.

err_no_player: You have not linked a player tag yet. Use /connect first.
err_no_snapshot: No card data yet. Run a full scan first.
err_permission: ⛔ You do not have permission for this action.
err_player_not_found: Player not found. Please check the tag.

err_route: Requests were blocked because the current egress IP is not the approved IP. Open /proxy to review the network configuration.
evo_manual: Evolutions are not carried by copy links — set them manually in the game.
evo_not_exposed: The API response did not include evolution data for this account.
gh_best_effort: GitHub Actions hosting is best-effort: jobs are limited to 6 hours, so the worker saves a checkpoint and starts the next run before the limit. It is not guaranteed uninterrupted hosting.
gh_dynamic_ip: This worker runs on a GitHub-hosted runner whose outbound IP changes on every run. Use a trusted proxy or VPS with a stable IP for the official API.
help_text: How to use the bot 🔗 /connect — link your player tag 🔍 /scan — full account scan (profile, cards, battles, clan) 🃏 /cards — browse your card collection 📊 /battles — battle history analysis 🎴 /decks — AI deck builder (8 categories) 📈 /meta — official balance changes and meta research 🤖 /analyze — ask the AI agent anything ⚙️ /settings — language, notifications, API key, network 🩺 /status — health of all components 🚫 /cancel — cancel running tasks Data honesty: the official API only returns your ~25 most recent battles and no in-game placements. The bot stores battles from the moment you link your tag, and always shows which data was retrieved, stored, calculated or unavailable. API key: a Supercell developer key is not your game password. Never share your game account credentials.
ip_instructions: How to allow the IP on your developer key 1. Open developer.clashroyale.com and sign in. 2. Go to My Account → Create New Key (or edit an existing key). 3. In “Allowed IP addresses”, enter the egress IP shown by “Check current IP” (the proxy IP if a proxy is active). 4. Save, copy the key and send it via Settings → API key. The bot cannot create a key for you. If the IP changes, the key stops working until you update it.
